confirmed_bug: Validated SceneSpec.background does not change rendered pixels in pinned Blender5.2.2

observations.factory: World.use_nodes=True; Background RGBA=(.050876088,.050876088,.050876088,1);Strength1; shader linked to World Output Surface;AgX/None/exposure0/gamma1

cause: scene_renderer.py:46 assigns World.color, but active node surface retains default Color. Blender5.2 World.use_nodes setter is compatibility no-op.

alternatives.option: Set existing Background shader Color to (*scene_data.background,1); retain linked World Output and Strength1
alternatives.impact: Keeps Cycles and current AgX/look/exposure/gamma. Changing world surface changes background AND environment illumination, hence can legitimately change foreground shading; do not promise identical foreground pixels. Scene RGB remains linear and display PNG is transformed, so white1 need not become255.
alternatives.scope: Only trusted compiler script, narrow native regression; no palette/view transform changes.

alternatives.option: Set world.use_nodes=False and continue world.color assignment
alternatives.impact: Not viable on pinned Blender5.2.2: actual getter remainsTrue after assignment; official5.2 API declares setter no-op. On older Blender fallback behavior differs, so not a portable substitution.
